title: 2D Contour: verify tabs and compensation across finish bands

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
Add tabbed finish sequences and supported Control and Wear sequences.
Depend on #4303 and the source-extension issue linked from #4204.
Follow the safety decisions in the research comment on #4204.

Fit leads and tabs at each offset. Check lead room across radial bands at shared depths.
Keep the crossing law active. Refuse a sequence when the configured leads cannot pass the current checks.
Check each tab bridge against cuts from all radial bands at shared depths.
Keep the required tab-top level in every band.
Keep existing refusals for open compensated runs, compensated tabs, blends, overlap and keep-down links.

Engage and cancel compensation independently for each supported band.
Preserve compensation records and notes when paths are combined. Rebase move indices with checked arithmetic.
Do not use operation::stitch without accounting for the metadata that it omits.
Retain every spring pass through path processing and posting.
Apply model, cutter, stock, flute, shank and holder checks to all generated motion.
A later failure must block posting. A diagnostic ghost must not count as a clean toolpath.

Evidence:
- crates/app/src/operation/stitch.rs, stitch.
- crates/cl/src/cl/path.rs, Toolpath; cl/comp.rs, CompSpan.
- crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour_comp.rs, door.
- crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour_whole_fence.rs and tab_clear.rs.
- crates/sim/src/verify/crossing.rs.
- docs/decisions/2677-shared-level-lead-fence.md.
- docs/decisions/2561-tab-bridge-all-cuts.md and 2579-tab-height-level.md.

Public reference: LinuxCNC G-code reference, G40 and G41/G42.
https://www.linuxcnc.org/docs/html/gcode/g-code.html
Preserve each post's controller-specific entry and cancel rules.

Done means: focused tests prove safe tab bridges across offsets and correct compensation spans after concatenation.
Posted tests count independent compensation engagement and cancellation for every band.
Posted tests count every requested final wall traversal, including spring passes.
A later collision, lead failure or tab failure blocks posting.
Cross-band crossing fixtures retain the existing verdict. Unsupported compensation combinations remain refused.
Disabled paths remain unchanged.

Effort: high. This work changes collision checks, tabs and posted G-code. The safety floor applies.
Priority: P6. This issue completes safety coverage for the feature.

Part of #4204
